'''Melana''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Sith Inquisitor]], she could be found at the [[House Thul (estate)|House Thul estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
